findings: Cache hits depend on path only, even after modification or deletion.
Inode grouping and comparison omit device; cross-device same-inode values collapse.
Hash and post-hash metadata can describe different contents; mutation control reproduces old digest plus new size.
Hash failure logged and swallowed; no typed caller failure or complete-success guard.
MD5 matches accepted without byte confirmation; injected collision merges distinct contents.
Concurrent inode membership check occurs outside inode lock; coordinated two-thread control admits same inode twice.
Malformed/truncated cache raises and loses valid-prefix loading.
Top-level module startup scans directories and may delete/hardlink files; never imported directly by controls.
Replacement removes original before link attempt, no rollback/source snapshot; not executed.
Unconditional winreg import and platform-specific filesystem probing prevent portable CLI qualification.
limits: Original AST function bodies executed unchanged with standard MD5 and real temporary files plus explicit collision/stat/race adapters. Full CLI, Windows registry/filesystem calls, destructive replacement and probabilistic stress not qualified.
